collection.description: After a difficult season, villagers debate whether remembrance should focus on suffering, survival or ordinary life.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a difficult season, villagers debate whether remembrance should focus on suffering, survival, or the ordinary lives that followed.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They weave bright ribbons for people they miss.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks to include a favorite silly story.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They propose a new form of remembrance.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They ask why some histories were left out.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They organize a gathering with quiet spaces.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They make room for people who do not wish to attend.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) speaks about joy that returned unexpectedly.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Another admits that healing never erased every scar.
